# Where to Watch Runner


by Angel | October 19, 2026


When a former soldier takes on a critical medical delivery, he finds himself caught in a deadly manhunt alongside an unlikely partner. With a cartel closing in and betrayal lurking around every corner, the two must navigate a dangerous chase and get their cargo where it needs to go before time runs out.


*Runner* brings together relentless action, unexpected humor, and a mission where failure could cost a little girl her life. Starring Alan Ritchson and Owen Wilson, this action-packed thriller is a race against the clock from start to finish.


[Stream Runner today on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/runner)


### **Alan Ritchson and Owen Wilson Make an Unlikely Team**


One of *Runner* ’s biggest draws is the pairing of Alan Ritchson and Owen Wilson. Ritchson brings the intensity and physical presence of a former soldier facing a relentless threat, while Wilson adds his signature wit and easygoing charm.


Their contrasting personalities create a dynamic that balances the film’s high-stakes action with plenty of humor. As the two men navigate an increasingly dangerous situation, their differences make for an entertaining partnership.


Audiences have praised the chemistry between the leads, with many highlighting how naturally the film blends action and comedy.


"Alan Ritchson and Owen Wilson have fantastic chemistry. Ritchson brings the heavy-hitting, no-nonsense action muscle, while Owen Wilson brings his signature charm, wit, and levity to the chaos. Watching them bounce off each other while racing against the clock gives it a classic, highly entertaining buddy-comedy dynamic." — ERBrit, IMDB


Whether they’re facing down danger or trading lines along the way, Ritchson and Wilson give the story an energy that keeps things moving.


### **Nonstop Action and Unexpected Twists**


*Runner* doesn’t give its characters much room to catch their breath. Chase sequences, intense confrontations, and unexpected turns keep the mission unpredictable as the cartel closes in.


Every detour threatens to derail the delivery, and every new obstacle raises the stakes. With betrayal complicating an already dangerous situation, the men can’t afford to assume they know who’s on their side.


For action fans, the film delivers the fast pace and hard-hitting sequences you’d expect from a high-stakes thriller. But it’s the combination of suspense, sharp comedic moments, and genuine emotional stakes that gives *Runner* its own personality.


### **More Than an Action Movie**


Beneath the chase scenes and close calls, *Runner* has a mission worth rooting for. A little girl’s life hangs in the balance, giving the story an emotional core that extends beyond the survival of its two leads.


The film explores sacrifice and the importance of fighting for someone who can’t fight for themselves. As the danger intensifies, the mission becomes a reminder that some things are worth risking everything to protect.


That balance of action and heart has resonated with audiences. Angel Guild members have praised the film for its emotional moments, engaging story, and ability to deliver excitement without losing sight of the people at the center of it all.


### **An Action-Packed Movie With Plenty of Heart**


With Alan Ritchson’s commanding action presence, Owen Wilson’s comedic timing, and a mission that keeps the stakes high, *Runner* offers an entertaining mix of thrills, laughs, and emotion.


The film has also earned an 89% verified audience score on Rotten Tomatoes, reflecting the enthusiasm of viewers who’ve enjoyed its blend of suspense, action, and unexpected heart.


Whether it’s the fast-paced action, the chemistry between the leads, or the race to save a young girl’s life, *Runner* gives audiences plenty to stay invested in until the final credits.


### **Watch** ***Runner*** **on Angel**


Two unlikely partners. One dangerous delivery. A little girl’s life hanging in the balance. *Runner* combines relentless action, unexpected humor, and a story with real emotional stakes in one high-energy thriller.


[Watch Runner now on Angel](https://www.angel.com/watch/runner) and join the race to get a life-saving delivery across the finish line.
